ownerReportedUpdates.hpi:
## Owner-provided current-illness HPI

Evidence: Owner's Telegram history; inpatient results and school statements are owner-relayed, not new signed veterinary records.

- August 31, 2026: Started Love Ur K9 puppy school; final leptospirosis booster that afternoon, per owner. Tired after each school day but otherwise okay and returned to normal each morning until September 5.
- September 4, 5 PM: School reported three big walks and advised no evening walk because she would be tired. At home tired, ate approximately 75% of dinner; owner notes this is not unusual for her selective appetite.
- September 5 morning: Did not rush out of her crate as usual. Persistent marked lethargy, refusal of food/water, hesitant to jump onto couch. By 10 PM resting respiratory rate in the 40s–50s prompted VEG ER visit.
- Initial ER: Fever to 104.1 F, focal thoracic tenderness, leukocytosis with mild left shift and thrombocytopenia; rapid lepto and parvo tests negative. Owner describes chest/abdominal/spinal radiographs as negative. Treated with subcutaneous fluids and an NSAID.
- September 6: Worsened the next morning and returned; admitted. At time of this report has received three doses of Unasyn; dose, route and administration times not supplied. Thoracic focal tenderness persists; greatest observed improvement after NSAIDs. Abdominal ultrasound and urinalysis reportedly negative. Manual platelet count reportedly 187; units not supplied. Do not presume true interval platelet recovery rather than automated/manual measurement difference.
- School: Love Ur K9 four-week Monday–Friday 9–4 program. Small puppies only, supervised play, solo walks. Staff reportedly observed no incident/injury, contacted other owners and found no other ill puppies. Thin metal slip-lead collar used for training, not walks; no prongs, with corrections described by school as very light. Exposure history does not establish an injury or cause.
- Background: Adopted from Carson/Gardena shelter June 18, 2026 after spay at approximately eight weeks; parents unknown. Initial vaccines and microchip at shelter.

Reconciliation: September 5 is the first clearly abnormal persistent systemic illness per this history; September 4 tiredness/reduced dinner and prior transient post-school fatigue remain documented, not erased. August 31 vaccination remains history-reported pending formal administration record. Earlier radiology report did not fully exclude gastric foreign material and considered slow transit/ileus; preserve that report rather than replacing it with an unqualified “normal.” Archived lepto test is Witness (antibody), not antigen; parvo SNAP is antigen. No new vaccine attachment accompanies this HPI message.
